intro: Run one shared command-based poll across Twitch, YouTube, Kick, and TikTok directly from the existing THSV chat intakes. No separate Streamer.bot commands or triggers are required.

sections.title: 1. Turn on universal polls
sections.notice: Keep the default ! prefix for the easiest setup. Opening and closing are announced to all four supported chats; vote confirmations remain in the viewer's source chat.

sections.title: 2. Poll behavior
sections.notice: Moderator: !poll open Best snack? | Cookies | Chips. Viewers: !vote 1. Moderator: !poll close. Closing sends results to chat and shows the result card for 12 seconds.

sections.title: Advanced: change command names
sections.notice: Change these only when another command already uses the same name. The names must remain different. Village Polls reads them directly from normalized chat.
